title: SLO-degradation playbook: acceptance criteria, customer-facing tiers, and PRD updates
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Translate postmortem action items from the regional outage (Dec 2024) into concrete PRD changes that define an SLO-degradation playbook: acceptance criteria, testable rollback gates, customer-facing impact tiers, and observability contract tests. Goal is to ensure serving runtime rollouts and autoscale paths have explicit pass/fail criteria, automated synthetic checks, and written messaging templates for customers when we hit degradation SLOs. Deliverables: updated PRD sections, acceptance criteria checklist, test harness plan, and a draft customer-facing SLA notice.
acceptance_criteria: PRD updated with a new 'SLO Degradation Playbook' section that lists degradation tiers (tier-1: transient high-latency <5min, tier-2: sustained throughput drop >10min, tier-3: regional outage) as discrete customer-impact states
Each tier must include a) exact observability triggers (metric, threshold, window), b) automated rollback or fallback action, and c) specific post-incident notification template
Integration test coverage: synthetic incident tests that simulate prefix-KV cache miss storm and autoscale cold-start delay; tests must pass in CI with deterministic pass/fail output
A set of contract tests for runtime to validate fallback compatibility across model variants (model A -> model A-quantized), including latency and token-cost assertions
Console change docs and UI copy for runtime page that display current degradation tier and recommended remediation steps to customers
Runbook acceptance: runbook steps for each tier validated by reliability engineering and included as PR links in the PRD
scope_changes: Add two new sections to the PRD: 'Observability contracts for SLO gates' and 'Synthetic incident matrix'
Require engineering to deliver a CI job that runs synthetic incident tests against a staging serving pool
Design to provide UI elements for degradation state and suggested actions (compact banner + detailed modal)
Add a non-goal: this ticket does not change customer billing or pricing copy; follow-up required from commercial team if that becomes necessary
notes_and_links: Related Linear tickets: PM-36214, PM-33107, ENG-4218
implementation_plan: Week 1: PM to workshop with Reliability and Serving teams to finalize tier definitions and observability signals (metrics + windows)
Week 2: Eng to prototype CI synthetic tests and a minimal alerting rule set; Design to produce banner and modal copy
Week 3: Iterate on test failures, capture clear pass/fail outputs, and author PRD text for acceptance criteria
Week 4: Run a dry-run simulated incident in staging; collect telemetry and update playbook thresholds
Week 5: Final review with Legal/Support for customer messaging templates and sign-off for runtime-1.20
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Synthetic tests produce nondeterministic flakiness and block CI - Mitigation: start with isolated test environment and require manual gating for first two cycles
Risk: Observability signal noise leading to false positives - Mitigation: require multi-signal confirmation (metric + tracing spike) before escalating tier
Risk: Customer confusion from automated degradation notices - Mitigation: craft precise templates with example impact statements and include recommended remediation steps
